The most World Women's Curling Championship titles is 19, achieved by Canada in 1980, 1984–87, 1989, 1993–94, 1996–97, 2000–01, 2004, 2007–08, 2017–2018 and 2024–25.
Canada extended their record with a 19th title at the 2025 World Women’s Curling Championship in in Uijeongbu, South Korea. They defeated Switzerland 7–3 in the final on 23 March 2025.
